# Regra 06: Ferramentas

Para garantir qualidade de código em projetos Node.js com TypeScript e React, siga as etapas abaixo para configurar ESLint e Prettier.

## Instalação das dependências

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint prettier eslint-plugin-react eslint-config-prettier
```

*Nota:* A configuração de regras adicionais como Airbnb pode ser feita manualmente, mas não é obrigatória para o funcionamento básico.

## Configuração do ESLint (`.eslintrc.json`)

```json
{
  "env": {
    "browser": true,
    "node": true
  },
  "extends": ["eslint:recommended", "plugin:react/recommended", "prettier"],
  "parserOptions": {
    "ecmaVersion": 2020,
    "sourceType": "module",
    "ecmaFeatures": { "jsx": true }
  },
  "rules": {
    "react/prop-types": "off"
  }
}
```

## Configuração do Prettier (`.prettierrc`)

```json
{
  "singleQuote": true,
  "trailingComma": "all",
  "printWidth": 100
}
```

## Configuração do lint-staged (`lint-staged.config.js`)

```js
module.exports = {
  "*.{js,jsx}": ["eslint --fix", "prettier --write"],
  "*.{ts,tsx}": ["eslint --fix", "prettier --write"]
}
```

## Scripts no `package.json`

Adicione:

```json
"scripts": {
  "lint": "eslint . --ext .js,.jsx,.ts,.tsx",
  "format": "prettier --write ."
}
```

## Integração com Husky (comandos)

```bash
npx husky install
npx husky add .husky/pre-commit "npx lint-staged"
```

Pronto! Agora toda vez que um commit for feito, o lint-staged será executado nos arquivos modificados.

*Observação:* O Airbnb style guide pode ser aplicado posteriormente instalando `eslint-config-airbnb` e ajustando o extends, mas isso fica para uma configuração mais avançada.

# Regra 06: Ferramentas

This skill provides guidelines for configuring ESLint and Prettier in a Node.js project with TypeScript and React. To ensure consistent code quality, start by installing the required dependencies:

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint prettier eslint-config-airbnb eslint-plugin-react @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin @typescript-eslint/parser
```

Create a `.eslintrc.json` file in your project root with the following base configuration:

```json
{
  "extends": ["airbnb", "airbnb/hooks"],
  "parser": "@typescript-eslint/parser",
  "plugins": ["@typescript-eslint"],
  "rules": {
    "react/jsx-filename-extension": [1, { "extensions": [".tsx"] }],
    "import/extensions": "off"
  }
}
```

For Prettier, add a `.prettierrc` file:

```json
{
  "semi": true,
  "singleQuote": true,
  "trailingComma": "es5",
  "printWidth": 100
}
```

You can run these tools manually using:

- `npx eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx` – lint all TypeScript and React files.
- `npx prettier --check .` – check formatting on all files.

To add convenient scripts to your `package.json`:

```json
"scripts": {
  "lint": "eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx",
  "format": "prettier --write .",
  "lint:check": "eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx && prettier --check ."
}
```

This setup allows you to run `npm run lint` and `npm run format` before committing. Make sure each developer has these dependencies installed and that your editor supports ESLint and Prettier extension integration. Custom rules can be added to the `rules` section of `.eslintrc.json` as needed.

# Setting Up ESLint, Prettier, and Husky for Your Project

This skill walks through configuring ESLint, Prettier, and Husky in a Node.js TypeScript React project. It assumes you have `npm` installed and a `package.json` already created.

## ESLint Configuration

Create `.eslintrc.json` in the project root:

```json
{
  "extends": [
    "airbnb",
    "airbnb/hooks",
    "plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended",
    "prettier"
  ],
  "parser": "@typescript-eslint/parser",
  "parserOptions": {
    "ecmaVersion": 2020,
    "sourceType": "module",
    "ecmaFeatures": {
      "jsx": true
    }
  },
  "rules": {
    // Extend or override as needed
  }
}
```

Add the required dev dependencies:

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint @typescript-eslint/parser @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin eslint-config-airbnb eslint-plugin-import eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y eslint-plugin-react eslint-plugin-react-hooks eslint-config-prettier
```

## Prettier Configuration

Create `.prettierrc`:

```json
{
  "semi": true,
  "singleQuote": true,
  "trailingComma": "all",
  "printWidth": 100,
  "tabWidth": 2
}
```

Install Prettier:

```bash
npm install --save-dev prettier
```

## Husky Setup

Initialize Husky and create a pre-commit hook:

```bash
npm install --save-dev husky
npx husky install
npx husky add .husky/pre-commit "npm run lint"
```

This hook runs the lint script before every commit.

## Package Scripts

Add the following to your `package.json`:

```json
"scripts": {
  "lint": "eslint src/ --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx",
  "format": "prettier --write \"src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,json,css,md}\"",
  "prepare": "husky install"
}
```

The `lint` script checks all files under `src/`. The `format` script applies Prettier formatting.

## Usage

After committing, Husky will automatically run `npm run lint`. If any ESLint errors are found, the commit will be blocked. Run `npm run format` periodically to keep formatting consistent.

This setup gives your team a solid foundation for code quality, using the Airbnb style guide as a base. Custom rules can be added inside the `rules` object of `.eslintrc.json`.

# Regra 06: Ferramentas

This skill provides guidelines and best practices for setting up code quality tooling in a Node.js project.

See ../../rules/06-tooling.md for detailed documentation.

## Configuration

Start by creating an `.eslintrc.json` file for ESLint. For a TypeScript + React project using Airbnb’s base style guide, use:

```json
{
  "extends": ["airbnb-typescript/base"],
  "parserOptions": {
    "project": "./tsconfig.json"
  },
  "rules": {
    "react/jsx-filename-extension": ["warn", { "extensions": [".tsx"] }]
  }
}
```

Place this in the project root. Ensure `eslint`, `@typescript-eslint/parser`, and `eslint-config-airbnb-typescript` are installed as dev dependencies.

## Running Checks

Add a script to `package.json`:

```json
"scripts": {
  "lint": "eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx"
}
```

Team members can run `npm run lint` before committing to catch issues manually. For formatting consistency, consider using EditorConfig (a `.editorconfig` file) to enforce basic whitespace rules across editors.

## Manual Steps

- Install required packages: `npm install --save-dev eslint @typescript-eslint/parser eslint-config-airbnb-typescript`
- Verify ESLint works with `npm run lint`
- Fix auto‑fixable issues with `npm run lint -- --fix`

This setup provides linting based on Airbnb’s rules with TypeScript support. For fully automated pre‑commit hooks integrating both linting and formatting, additional configuration (not covered here) would be needed.
